differences.what: the camera: no pinhole camera draws this engraving within about 2 m (the solve says why), so its render is not the engraving's view; the front's length, the walls' height, the corner's cut and the conservatory's place are judged on the two photographs' views (chicagology_923_photo, daily_news_dn0003324), where T-3271 builds them to Hunt's plan

the south flank's first window column behind the canted corner: its chamber window carries an iron balcony on consoles, as the front's do; the render's has none T-3271 (the sign-off): built: its chamber balcony on two consoles.

the basement lights: the engraving draws them round-headed, under the front and the conservatory; the render's are square-headed T-3271 (the sign-off): cut round-headed, K06's round-headed basement light.
the conservatory's curved glass roof with an iron-railed deck at the chamber floor, and its tall barred lights on a stone base
the stoop between stone cheeks before the door, the iron cresting, the dormers: drawn as the photographs show them; a tree in leaf hides the front's middle and most of the mansard

the fence: the engraving's is the scroll-pattern fence of 1893 or before; the 1904 fence is judged on the Daily News view T-3271 (the sign-off): The render builds the c. 1905 negative's tall spear fence for 1904.
the brick's colour: the picture is monochrome
the north flank, the rear and the rear ranges: out of the picture's sight

the basement: the picture shows the house standing on a pale dressed-stone basement up to the water table (2.0 m), its round-headed lights cut in it; the render's basement is the walls' brick carried down to grade, as K01 lays a brick front with no K02 stone below it. Building it wants the front as a stone basement under brick (stone_front with brick_above_m at the water table), which T-3271 did not reach: a wrong material a visitor would see.

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
